H2420: a puzzle, hence, a trick, conundrum, sententious maxim

H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed

H3366: value, i.e. (concretely) wealth; abstractly, costliness, dignity

H2088: the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that
H1870: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb

H7521: to be pleased with; specifically, to satisfy adebt

H389: a particle of affirmation, surely; hence (by limitation) only
H3027: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),

H1: father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application
H216: illumination or (concrete) luminary (in every sense, including lightning, happiness, etc.)
H995: to separate mentally (or distinguish), i.e.(generally) understand
